definition.simple: The most basic building block of everything, like a single color of a Lego block that you can't break into other colors.
definition.academic: A pure substance consisting only of atoms that all have the same numbers of protons in their nuclei. It cannot be broken down into simpler substances by chemical means.

common_misconceptions: Thinking that elements only exist as single atoms (they can exist as molecules like O2).
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student to imagine breaking down a pure copper wire repeatedly. What is the final thing left?
